remarks:
35 scenic acres in the heart of Wyoming County offering exceptional potential and a story generations in the making. Owned by the same family since the 1970s, this special property was thoughtfully created as a peaceful cabin retreat and envisioned as a private homestead surrounded by nature. Although life eventually took the owner elsewhere, the dream of returning to this cherished property always remained close to heart for decades.
A beautiful mix of different types of woods, open space, abundant wildlife, and a picturesque shared pond creates the perfect backdrop for your future vision. With over 600 feet of road frontage on two separate roads, the property offers flexibility and opportunity, including the potential to divide the acreage into two separate parcels. Existing improvements include a spring-fed well and septic with concrete holding tank, providing a strong foundation for future building plans or recreational use.
Whether you are dreaming of a private country home, a proven hunting retreat, recreational getaway, or short-term rental investment, this property offers endless possibilities. Conveniently located near the Village of Attica and Warsaw with easy access to both Rochester and Buffalo, you can enjoy the peace of rural living without sacrificing accessibility. Rarely does a property combine privacy, natural beauty, history, and future potential quite like this.
